headline: Argentine banks to remain closed Friday for Bank Employee Day
summary: Argentine banking institutions will keep their doors closed on Friday, November 6, in observance of Bank Employee Day holiday commemorations.
why: Bank holidays halt domestic clearing services, retail branch banking, and local FX settlement operations.

impacts.name: Argentine Banking Sector
impacts.why: Banks will keep doors closed for the holiday.
